title: Study on key technologies for resource recovery and high-value transformation of main charge in decommissioned explosive tear gas grenades
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20184-20193
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01583B, Paper

Xing Fang, Dandan Liu, Hualei Yang, Xubo Shen, Xianjun Xie, Zhenhui Li, Tongmei Hu, Zhangyan Hu, Yongyang Mao, Zhihao Yi
A resource-oriented strategy was developed for the sustainable and harmless treatment of decommissioned tear gas grenades (DTGG), focusing on efficient recovery of CS and its conversion into value-added chemicals.
